vocabulary.pan: Translate 6–10% of frame (≥60px) over 2–3s, overscale 1.12 to hide edges, origin photo.meta.focus; easing cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1); bounds: never linear, no consecutive same direction, text stays x60..1020 y120..1620, WAAPI/__onFrame only, seeded values
vocabulary.parallax: 3 layers: bg 0.6x (blur 24px, scale 1.15), card 1x, text 1.4x moving opposite to photo; dolly 1→1.08 over shot; easing cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0.2,1); bounds: bg never exposes edges, text inside safe area, contrast ≥4.5:1, counts as 2 motion channels
vocabulary.wipe: clip-path bar/diagonal/inset 280–400ms, slat blinds 45ms stagger; easing cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); bounds: ≤380ms in moody-night, frame 0 ≥80% visible, last frame never mid-wipe, clip change ≥0.08 counts as change
vocabulary.split: 2/3/4 cells or 1+2 bento, 12px gutter, active cell 45→62% in 400ms, opposite per-cell zoom 1→1.06 / 1.06→1; easing cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); bounds: photo.maxUses 2, noAdjacent, minSceneSec 1.0, cells count as visual beats
vocabulary.grid: 2x2 grid 12px gutter, cells reveal 80ms stagger 300ms each, each cell drift 1→1.04; easing cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); bounds: photo.maxUses 2, no same photo in adjacent cells, ≤2 text blocks, text ≤35% area
vocabulary.stack: Card drop from -120px with damped spring 500ms (overshoot ≤6%), rotation ±2.5°, in-frame drift 1→1.04, peel-off 350ms; easing cubic-bezier(0.34,1.4,0.64,1); bounds: ≤3 visible cards, rotation seeded within ±2.5°, text upright and readable
vocabulary.flip: rotateY 0→180° over 400ms, perspective 1200px, backface hidden, swap content at 90°; easing cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); bounds: no mirrored text, ≤1 flip per shot, not on final frame
vocabulary.punch: Scale 1→1.12 in 250ms then hold; chain wide→medium→macro ≤3 steps within one photo around photo.meta.focus; easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); bounds: snap to beat ±60ms, upscale never exceeds source sharpness, beat-cut minSceneSec 0.45 only
vocabulary.whip: Horizontal translate 100% in 140ms + 12px motion blur; easing cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1); bounds: no text visible during whip, alternate direction each use, never on last frame
vocabulary.slide: Push/slide 100% in 320ms; card alternate left/right with 2° tilt; easing cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); bounds: no consecutive same direction, cards end inside safe area, displacement ≥60px
vocabulary.kinetic: Word/phrase mask reveal 70–120ms stagger, entry 80–320ms, highlighter swipe 300ms, stamp slam 1.5→1.0 260ms, count-up only real numbers; easing cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); bounds: no Korean per-glyph scatter, no photo-in-glyph masks, stamp only real price/badge, dwell ≥max(1.0,0.4+0.10×chars), ≤3.5s static, grounded text
vocabulary.badge: Pill badge scale 0→1.08→1 in 260ms, micro accent 1→1.025→1 160ms on beat 1/CTA; easing cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); bounds: grounded facts only, ≥36px text, contrast ≥4.5:1, inside safe area
vocabulary.light-leak: CSS radial-gradient steam/rays/bokeh overlay, opacity 0→0.35, drift at 1.8x camera speed; easing cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1); bounds: under-text contrast stays ≥4.5:1, CSS only, no external assets
vocabulary.grain: Inline SVG feTurbulence or CSS noise, opacity 0.06–0.12, offset stepped via __onFrame from seeded table at 1.8x speed; easing steps(8); bounds: no Math.random/rAF, not counted alone as a motion channel for sceneDisplacement
vocabulary.tilt: Vertical translate 6–10% of height (≥60px) over 2–3s, or handheld micro drift ±1.2°; easing cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1); bounds: overscale ≥1.08 to hide edges, alternate up/down, rotation ≤1.2°
vocabulary.ramp: Speed ramp slow→fast→slow: 30%/40%/30% of time covers 10%/80%/10% of travel, scale 1→1.15 or ≥60px move; easing cubic-bezier(0.83,0,0.17,1); bounds: linear forbidden, total duration within beat grid ±10%
vocabulary.rack-focus: Blur 10px→0 over 500–700ms with scale 1→1.03 centered on photo.meta.focus; easing cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1); bounds: main visual opacity ≥0.85 at 0.05s, no black fade-in, blur dissolves ≤380ms
vocabulary.loupe: Circular PiP 360px diameter at 2.5x on detail with pin + leader line; match zoom next cut starts at 2.5 detail crop and pulls to 1.0 over 600–800ms; easing cubic-bezier(0.83,0,0.17,1); bounds: loupe inside safe area, label text grounded, ≥36px
vocabulary.film: 3-frame vertical strip, CSS sprockets, advance one frame in 700ms with ease-stop hold ≤1.0s, active frame 1.06, neighbors brightness 0.55; easing cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); bounds: lowEnergyStretch ≤1.0s, photo.maxUses 2, noAdjacent
vocabulary.iris: Circle/arch clip-path from focus, 400–450ms, hook variant starts at radius covering ≥80% of frame; easing cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); bounds: frame 0 ≥80% visible, last frame not mid-iris, clip change ≥0.08
vocabulary.cut: Hard cut snapped to beat/half-beat grid ±60ms, minSceneSec 1.0 (beat-cut 0.45), micro accent 1→1.025→1 160ms; easing step; bounds: 0.5–0.9s cuts carry 0–4 chars, no equal-length splits, ≥80% cuts on beat

variation:
1. Seed = hash(storeId, menuIds, selected options, takeIndex); remake increments takeIndex for a different video, same take reproduces exactly; seed resolved pre-scene and embedded as a value table, no Math.random/rAF in scene code.
2. Rhythm skeletons: 3–4 per (length, tempo) prewritten in directives and snapped to beat grid, e.g. 10s-burst [1.2,1.0,1.3,1.5,2.5,2.5], 10s-story [1.8,2.7,3.0,2.5], 10s-split [1.5,3.0,3.0,2.5]; seed picks one; equal splits forbidden.
3. Shot order seeded from hero-first / journey-first (exterior→display→macro→hands) / grid-first; no two consecutive shots with same move and direction; alternate direction and zoom-in/zoom-out.
4. Rotate the reference's 3–6 allowed moves in seeded order; transitions split primary 70% / secondary 30%.
5. Parameter jitter: duration ±10% within beat grid, rotation ±2°, easing chosen from 3, accent colors max 2 from store palette, sub-palette 2–3 options, caption position 2–3 options.
6. Copy angle rotation: 4–6 slot phrases per (concept, mood), e.g. menu name+type / menu name with observed ingredient / real benefit+menu name / store's menu name; fact gate: a slot is used only if its fact exists in the fact bundle; HCX only chooses enums and fills slots.
7. Fixed: store name, per-reference font pair (Navis Sans / Navis Serif only, future font slot empty), safe margins, caption zone, grounded text only; no logo.
metrics:
1. Checker: extend check-scene.mjs browser probe (boxes, opacity, clip, text) sampled on a 0.25s grid; optional 2nd pass ffmpeg frame-diff on rendered mp4 for visible motion.
2. lowEnergyStretch: no-change span (box ≥8px, opacity/clip ≥0.08, text change) ≤1.0s fast/mid, ≤1.5s calm; ending scene exempt.
3. sceneDisplacement: every non-final scene photo/card scale ≥8% or move/clip ≥60px.
4. moveVariety: ≥3 distinct moves, 0 consecutive identical (direction, move), no move >40% of shots.
5. layeredMotion: ≥2 distinct channels (camera/text/overlay/layout) per scene except minimal references; 6% zoom alone fails.
6. nonLinearEasing: ≥70% of animations non-linear; auxiliary only, never sole pass/fail.
7. cutCount (visual beats; fast/mid/calm): 10s ≥5/4/3, 15s ≥8/5/4, 30s ≥14/8/6.
8. rhythmVariance: with ≥3 scenes, non-final lengths must differ (max−min ≥0.4s) or fail.
9. maxShotLen: 10s ≤3s, 15s ≤3.5s, 30s ≤4s; CTA hold ≤2.5s exception.
10. hook.firstSecond: main visual opacity ≥0.85 at 0.05s, within 0–1s move ≥60px or ≥1 clip/text entry, frame0≠frame15.
11. text.dwell: min max(1.0s, 0.4+0.10×chars), max 3.5s static unanimated text (ending exempt), entry 80–320ms (hard-cut references exempt), ≤2 simultaneous blocks, textless span ≤3s, text area ≤35% of frame.
12. fast-text: 0.5–0.9s cuts carry 0–4 chars.
13. contrast/safe area: contrast ≥4.5:1, text within x 60..1020 / y 120..1620, min 36px overall (rules.json), main caption/hook ≥52px; platform UI margins rechecked at implementation.
14. beatAlign: ≥80% of cuts within ±60ms of a beat.
15. CTA: store name visible in last 1.5s; last frame must not be mid-transition.
16. grounding: all text present in fact bundle.
17. On failure: auto-retry with a different seed (max 2), then fall back to the safest reference grammar.
